description: This file defines a React functional component named 'GenericKeyValueManager' used for managing key-value pairs with features such as adding, editing, deleting, and optional collapsibility. It includes UI elements for input, table display, and various actions, supporting customization via props.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID for new key-value items.

methods.name: handleAddItem
methods.description: Handles adding a new key-value item after validating input.

methods.name: handleEditItem
methods.description: Initiates editing state for a specific item.

methods.name: handleSaveEdit
methods.description: Saves edits made to a key-value item, updating the list.

methods.name: handleCancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the editing state without saving changes.

methods.name: handleDeleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a specified key-value item from the list.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Triggers the onSave callback if provided.
